mock.appUnavailable: This feature is unavailable in the browser.
mock.outsideApp: This feature is only available in the app.

error.coreUnreachable: NetsuBoard’s background service isn’t responding. Try again; if it keeps happening, restart the app.
error.diskFull: The disk is full. Free up some space, then try again.
error.notFound: File not found. It may have been moved or deleted.
error.permission: Access denied. The file may be read-only or open in another app.
error.busy: Another app is using the file. Close it, then try again.
error.timeout: No response in time. Try again.
error.internal: Internal NetsuBoard error. The details are in Settings › Console.
